items.name: Claude Code
items.blurb: Anthropic's coding agent. Runs right here in a tab.
items.explain: Downloads an installer from claude.ai and runs it. Puts a `claude` command in ~/.local/bin, and keeps itself updated after that.

items.name: Gemini CLI
items.explain: Installs Google's agent through npm, so it needs Node first. Gives you a `gemini` command.

items.name: Codex CLI
items.explain: Installs OpenAI's agent through npm, so it needs Node first. Gives you a `codex` command.

items.name: Homebrew
items.blurb: The thing most Mac install instructions assume you have.
items.explain: Downloads Homebrew's own installer and runs it. It will ask for your password, because it writes outside your home folder.

items.name: Node
items.blurb: Needed by Gemini CLI and Codex CLI.
items.explain: Installs Node and npm using Homebrew. Install Homebrew first if you have not.

items.name: Git and Apple's developer tools
items.blurb: Version control, and the compilers a lot of installs quietly need.
items.explain: Opens Apple's own installer for the command line developer tools. Nothing is downloaded until you agree in the window that appears.

items.name: Check my setup
items.blurb: Prints which of these are installed, and which are missing.
items.command: for t in claude gemini codex node npm git brew; do printf '%-8s ' "$t"; command -v $t >/dev/null && echo installed || echo 'not installed'; done
items.explain: Looks for each tool and prints whether it is there. Changes nothing.

items.name: Why isn't Claude working?
items.explain: Prints Claude Code's install health and settings problems. Read-only — it does not start a session or change anything.
